fusions.name: Puffball Slam
fusions.desc: Slams your shield down in a burst of spores, dealing 10 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and leaving each [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on each one spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Mould on the Rim
fusions.desc: A strike with the mould-grown rim of your shield that deals 4 damage and leaves the target [Diseased] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Mycelial Mat
fusions.desc: Roots a bed of spores around your shield for 8 seconds that restores 3 health a second to you and every ally within 4 tiles.

fusions.name: Slow Fruiting
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 8. When you reach 8, they all spend at once: you are healed for 3% of your maximum health per stack (20% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds. You also regenerate 0.5 health a second.
